gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-sulphur-point: Familiar and playful, Minecraftia lingers on every character, with thin diagonals leaning against heavy vertical stems. Sulphur Point then smooths things over, its strokes joining without thinning or bulging.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-ubuntu-sans: Minecraftia sets stout stems against slim hairlines, giving each character its own lingering beat. Ubuntu Sans takes over with tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe drawn with a ballpoint.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-vend-sans: Heavy stems carry hair-thin arms in Minecraftia, and each character lingers. Vend Sans draws a ruler-drawn, constant-width line, so a full block of text reads steadily, horizontals no thinner than verticals.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-alexandria: Zero modulation runs through Nasalization, its letters floating well apart. Up top it excels at standing apart with a calipers-shaped c, whereas Alexandria does its best work in clean sans-serif, low in modulation with generous terminals.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-amiko: Amiko sets lowercase as high as a thick crayon mark, with terminals pointing outward like tongs. Amiko holds up at body size, but Nasalization made small would lose the floating spacing that makes it friendly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-devanaga: Friendly and approachable, Nasalization keeps its bold-looking and light-looking strokes from ever mixing in a single word. Nasalization announces, while Anek Devanagari does the reading, its letter mouths distinctly open.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-kannada: Friendly and floating, Nasalization outlines each counter in a single steady thickness. Anek Kannada rises beside it with a squared-off woodblock x-height and terminals that stop far from the stem, adding a contemporary edge.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin holds its lowercase nearly to capital height, letters held open rather than curled shut. Anek Latin carries the text while Nasalization, with no hairlines at all, plays the friendly signpost.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-malayala: Anek Malayalam keeps its lowercase close to capital height, with curve tips that stop short of touching. Nasalization floats well apart, stems and arcs in lockstep, and feels friendly.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads with wide, high bowls, its rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. And Nasalization, cut from one gauge of tubing, gives the pairing its friendly, uniform backbone.
